d: Esaaaeeaar ke tahat dava-aapatti charan men prapt aavednon ke dijitaijeshan ka kary lagatar jari hai. ab tak solah lakh se adhik prapatron ka dijitaijeshan kiya ja chuka hai. vahin, eesdi suchi men shamil matdataon ko ek bar phir matdata suchi men apna nam jurvane ka avsar diya ja raha hai. dusri or, jharkhand samet deshbhar men govardhan puja aur kali puja ki dhum dekhne ko mili. shraddhaluon ne gau mata ki puja-archana kar annakut ka bhog lagaya. kaee sthanon par bhagvan chitragupt ki bhi vidhi-vidhan se puja ki gaee. vahin, indiyan skul oph kol mainejment ka sthapna divas aaj manaya ja…
